index.about.h2: I’m Champika Rathnayaka (Champi), the photographer behind Ella Sri Lanka Photographer.
index.about.paragraph1: From hidden scenic locations to breathtaking sunrise viewpoints and peaceful tea estates, I love helping travelers discover the most beautiful sides of Ella while creating unforgettable memories through photography.
index.about.paragraph2: Since 2019, I have specialized in proposal, couples, pre-wedding, solo, family, and travel photography for visitors exploring Sri Lanka. My photography style focuses on natural emotions, real moments, and cinematic storytelling in a relaxed and friendly atmosphere.
index.about.paragraph3: More than simply taking photos, my goal is to help people connect beautiful memories with the incredible landscapes of Ella. Seeing clients happy and creating experiences they will always remember brings me genuine joy.
index.about.paragraph4: Many of my clients come through recommendations from previous travelers, which means a lot to me and motivates me to continue creating meaningful experiences for every couples and visitor I work with.

Last a Lifetime
about.intro.paragraph1: Hello — I'm Champika Rathnayaka, a fine-art wedding and portrait photographer based between Ella and the world's most breathtaking landscapes. With over a decade behind the lens, I've come to believe that the best photographs don't interrupt a moment — they grow out of it.
about.intro.paragraph2: My work is rooted in documentary storytelling, shaped by a love of light, texture, and the quiet in-between seconds that reveal who people truly are. Whether it's the way a bride laughs at her own nerves, or two people sharing a glance that needs no words — those are the frames I live for.
about.intro.paragraph3: Photography is the art of making the invisible — feeling, joy, love — visible.

explore.hero.p: 12 Best Photography Spots in Ella, Sri Lanka
explore.infro.h2: Best Photography Spots in Ella, Sri Lanka
explore.infro.p2: Ella, Sri Lanka, is one of the most beautiful destinations on the island for photography. Surrounded by lush green mountains, tea plantations, waterfalls, railway tracks and spectacular viewpoints, Ella offers incredible locations for couple photoshoots, honeymoon photography, pre-wedding sessions, surprise proposals, solo portraits, family photography and travel photography.
explore.infro.p3: From the iconic Nine Arch Bridge and breathtaking Little Adam's Peak to scenic tea plantations, the Nanu Oya–Ella train journey, Ella Swing, waterfalls, hidden viewpoints and romantic proposal locations — explore every spot below and start planning your Ella photography experience. 📸
excplore.best-time.h2: What's the Best Time for Photography in Ella?
excplore.best-time.p2: Choosing the right time is just as important as choosing the right location. Tap a time of day below, then scroll down — the spots that shine at that time will glow in the list.
excplore.best-time.p3: Showing all photography spots — scroll down to explore the full list below.
explore.location-01.p1: The Nine Arch Bridge is one of the most famous landmarks in Ella and one of the best photography spots in Ella, Sri Lanka.
explore.location-01.p2: Surrounded by lush green jungle and mountains, this historic railway bridge creates the classic Ella travel photograph. The location becomes even more spectacular when a train passes across the bridge.
explore.location-01.p3: For couples and honeymooners, the bridge provides a beautiful combination of architecture, nature, and Sri Lanka’s famous railway scenery.
explore.location-02.p1: Little Adam’s Peak is one of the most popular viewpoints in Ella and one of the best places for couple photography and surprise proposals.
explore.location-02.p2: The walk to the viewpoint is relatively accessible, and once you reach the top, you are rewarded with spectacular views across Ella’s green mountains and valleys.
explore.location-02.p3: The location is especially beautiful around sunrise and sunset when the mountains are covered in soft, warm light.
explore.location-03.p1: If you want something more adventurous, Ella Rock is one of the best photography locations around Ella.
explore.location-03.p2: The hike is more challenging than Little Adam’s Peak, but the dramatic mountain views make it worthwhile.
explore.location-03.p3: From the top, you can capture wide landscape photographs as well as adventurous portraits.
explore.location-04.p1: The Nanu Oya to Ella train journey is one of the most scenic railway experiences in Sri Lanka.
explore.location-04.p2: The route travels through the hill country, passing tea plantations, mountains, forests, tunnels, railway bridges, and misty valleys.
explore.location-04.p3: For photography, this journey is perfect for natural, candid and cinematic images.
explore.location-05.p1: Ella is surrounded by beautiful tea-growing areas, making the tea plantations in Ella one of the best locations for natural photography.
explore.location-05.p2: The endless rows of green tea plants combined with mountain scenery create an elegant Sri Lankan backdrop.
explore.location-05.p3: This location works particularly well for honeymoon and pre-wedding photography.
explore.location-06.p1: Ravana Falls is one of the most popular natural attractions near Ella.
explore.location-06.p2: The waterfall, rocks and surrounding tropical greenery create a completely different photography environment compared with the mountain viewpoints.
explore.location-07.p1: The Ella Swing is a fun photography experience for travellers who want something different from traditional mountain viewpoints.
explore.location-07.p2: With the mountains and greenery in the background, the swing can create beautiful and playful photographs.
explore.location-07.p3: It is especially popular for couples and solo travellers looking for memorable travel photographs.
explore.location-08.p1: If you want to include something cultural in your Ella photography experience, Mahamevnawa Buddhist Monastery offers a peaceful setting.
explore.location-08.p2: The architecture, Buddhist surroundings and scenic environment create a different visual style from the typical mountain and railway photographs.
explore.location-09.p1: Ella is an incredible destination for a surprise marriage proposal.
explore.location-09.p2: While famous viewpoints such as Little Adam’s Peak are beautiful, a quieter and more private location can sometimes create a much more intimate experience.
explore.location-10.p1: If you have additional time during your Sri Lanka trip, travelling from Ella towards Haputale and Lipton’s Seat can provide spectacular landscape photography opportunities.
explore.location-10.p2: The area is famous for its tea estates, misty mountains and panoramic views over the surrounding countryside.
explore.location-11.p1: If you prefer quieter locations away from busy tourist attractions, a Secret Waterfall can be a great option.
explore.location-11.p2: Surrounded by greenery, rocks and flowing water, this type of location creates a more natural and adventurous photography experience.
explore.location-12.p1: If you want photographs that feel more private and less like typical tourist photographs, consider exploring some of the quieter viewpoints around Ella.
explore.location-12.p2: These locations can be ideal for couples and honeymooners who want natural photographs without large groups of tourists in the background.
explore.tips.h2: Tips for Getting the Best Photos in Ella
explore.tips.01.span: Choose the location based on your style
explore.tips.01.p: Don't choose a location just because it's famous. Think about whether you want mountains, tea plantations, trains, waterfalls, culture or romantic sunset photographs.
explore.tips.02.p: The same location can look completely different in morning and evening light — this guide's time suggestions above are a great starting point.
explore.tips.03.p: Light, neutral colours work beautifully against Ella's green landscapes, while elegant outfits create a more sophisticated pre-wedding look.
explore.tips.04.p: Some locations are close to Ella town, while others require hiking or driving. Avoid planning too many locations without enough time between them.
explore.tips.05.p: A local photographer can help with posing, composition, lighting, location selection and timing so you don't have to worry about what to do in front of the camera.
explore.local.h2: Why Choose a Local Ella Photographer?
explore.local.p2: Ella may look beautiful everywhere, but knowing where to go, when to go and how to photograph each location makes all the difference. Instead of simply taking photographs at tourist attractions, the goal is to create an experience and photographs that feel personal to you.
